sentence: Most designs are associational, and the hospital evidence states the consequence from inside the corpus: assessing AI's payoff requires endogeneity controls
passage: [Pham et al. (2024), p. 1] "Importantly, we demonstrate that controlling for endogeneity is essential in assessing the performance outcomes of AI adoption."
